name: The Broken Script [HUGE UPDATE]
desc:

The longer you stay, the harder it becomes to tell what's part of the world… and what's watching you from within it

CONTROLS

TAB — Settings
Z — Zoom
SHIFT — Sprint
F — Toggle Break / Place Mode
Middle Mouse — Grab Block
G — Hybrid Mode
Left Click — Break
Right Click — Place
